# transparentedge_transcoding_allowed_values (Data Source)

Allowed values for the transcoding profile enums.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "transparentedge_transcoding_allowed_values" "all" {}

output "allowed_video_formats" {
  value = data.transparentedge_transcoding_allowed_values.all.video_formats
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `audio_codecs` (List of String) Allowed values for `audio_codec`.
- `video_aspect` (List of String) Allowed values for `video_aspect`.
- `video_codecs` (List of String) Allowed values for `video_codec`.
- `video_formats` (List of String) Allowed values for `video_format`.
